Area #1 has 19 sites with electricity') + ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for parkId 880116 (every Modern Electric site lists 50-amp; none lists water or sewer), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Two camping areas along Kettle Creek, all with level gravel pads. DCNR counts 43 electric sites (24 in Area #2, 19 in Area #1); the booking site lists 54 Modern Electric and 23 Modern Non-Electric sites. Listed max vehicle lengths are 20-40 ft (13 sites at 40 ft, most 25-30). Every campsite is listed back-in.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/ole-bull-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880116 (site list and each site's details page: Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry) + the DCNR stay page, read 2026-10-20

values.note: DCNR: 'Water hydrants, modern restrooms, and a sanitary dump station are available.' The booking page lists the nearest laundry as more than 10 miles away.

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/ole-bull-state-park/stay + ReserveAmerica Services and Amenities for parkId 880116 (Hot Showers, Dump Station, 'Greater Than 10 Miles: Laundry'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Campsites can be booked up to 11 months ahead and for the same day (ReserveAmerica booking window).

booking.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/ole-bull-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880116 (Booking Window for Modern Electric and Modern Non-Electric: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window for this park; year-round season already manual. Added 50-amp electric (no water/sewer at sites), 77 back-in sites to 40 ft, hot showers/dump/water hydrants, no laundry nearby. Not stated for this park: min/max stay, noon cutoff, fcfs, flush toilets by name. Fees left as recorded (statewide table). Stored riverfront agrees with ReserveAmerica's 'Waterfront' tag on 22 RV sites.
